meta.name: understand-onboard
meta.description: Use when you need to generate an onboarding guide for new team members joining a project

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成新成员快速上手的入门指南
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 需要帮新成员快速上手项目
copy.tagline_en: Generate a quick-start guide for new team members
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're welcoming new teammates and want them up to speed fast.

howto.what: Claude 会读取项目已有的知识图谱，据此生成一份面向新成员的中文入职指南，内容包含项目概览、架构层次、关键概念、导览、文件地图和复杂度较高的区域，并以 Markdown 呈现，还可建议保存到 docs/ONBOARDING.md。
howto.when: 当用户需要为刚加入项目的新团队成员生成入职指南时触发。

say.text: 为这个项目生成新成员入职指南
say.note: Claude 会从知识图谱读取信息并生成指南。

say.text: 按知识图谱的层次结构和导览整理一份 Markdown 指南。
say.note: 输出包含架构分层与推荐学习路径。

say.text: 把这份入职指南保存到 docs/ONBOARDING.md
say.note: 之后会询问是否保存到该路径。

howto.what_en: Claude reads the project's knowledge graph and generates an onboarding guide for new team members, covering project overview, architecture layers, key concepts, a guided tour, a file map, and complexity hotspots, formatted as Markdown, with an offer to save it to docs/ONBOARDING.md.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs to create an onboarding guide for new team members joining a project.

say_en.text: Generate an onboarding guide for new members of this project.
say_en.note: Claude reads the knowledge graph and produces the guide.

say_en.text: Write a Markdown guide based on the graph's layers and tour.
say_en.note: Output includes architecture layers and a recommended path.
Claude suggests saving and committing it to the repo.
